implementation: VaultIP supporting AES(GCM) with null AAD.
description: VaultIP is a Silicon IP Security Module which includes a complete set of high- and low-level cryptographic functions. It offers key management and crypto functions needed for platform and application security such as Content Protection and Mobile Payment, and can be used stand-alone or as a 'Root of Trust' to support a TEE-based platform.
